```{r}
library(ISLR)
library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
data("Boston")
Boston=data.frame(Boston)
```
```{r}
?Boston
```
```{r}
head(Boston)
tail(Boston)
```

```{r}
dim(Boston)
```
```{r}
crim_med=rep(0,nrow(Boston))
crim_med[Boston$crim>median(Boston$crim)]=1
Boston=data.frame(Boston,crim_med)
set.seed(312)
training_data=sample(nrow(Boston),size=0.75*nrow(Boston))
length(training_data)
```
```{r}
glm_fit=glm(crim_med~.,data = Boston,subset=train,family = "binomial")
```
```{r}
summary(glm_fit)
```
```{r}
glm_probs=predict(glm_fit,Boston[-train,],type="response")
glm_pred=rep("No",dim(Boston[-train,])[1])
glm_pred[glm_probs>0.5]="Yes"
table(glm_pred, Boston[-train,"crim_med"],dnn = c("Predicted","Actual"))
```
